messages:
Sam (People Ops): Thanks everyone — follow-up thread from today's all-hands People Ops Q&A. We'll answer promos/leveling/comp questions here. Drop short Qs and we'll tag the right folks.

Jules (SWE): Quick one — timeline for next promotion cycle?

Sam (People Ops): Good Q. Promo cycle window opens May 6 and closes May 24. Managers submit calibration packets by May 31. Results communicated by June 14.

Noah (SWE): If I want to be considered, what should I put in the packet vs what my manager writes?

Marta (HRBP): Short answer: you add a 2–3 bullet self-summary + 1 example of impact. Manager provides evidence, calibration rating recommendation, and growth plan. Do not paste full PR history — concise impact statements help.

Ava (Data Scientist): Are career ladders updated anywhere? I want to see level expectations for DS roles.

Sam (People Ops): Yes — ladders are in Confluence: https://redwood.growth/careerladders (under People Ops -> Ladders). If you don't have access ping @Sam.

Priya (Eng Manager): One clarification about peer feedback: we only accept up to 3 peer notes per candidate in the packet. Please ask peers to be specific (metrics, project names, timeline).

Jules (SWE): Is there a process for retroactive compensation adjustments if a promo was delayed?

Lily (Finance): We can do retroactive merit for promotions approved within the cycle window — typically effective date is the communication date, and pay is prorated back to the effective date. Exceptions require VP approval.

Noah (SWE): What about equity refreshes? Any change this year?

Diego (CEO): Equity refresh policy hasn't materially changed. We prioritize based on retention risk and level. People Ops + Finance will start outreach in Q3 for high-impact roles. If you think you're missing a refresh conversation, DM @Sam + your manager.

Sam (People Ops): On comp bands: we use market-anchored bands per level; comp discussions happen in 1:1s during calibration weeks. There's no public individual salaries, but managers will discuss range placement privately.

Ava (Data Scientist): Is there an appeals process if I disagree with calibration outcome?

Marta (HRBP): Yes — appeals open for 7 business days after result communication. Process: 1) talk to manager, 2) if unresolved, submit appeal form (link in ladder doc), 3) HR will triage and escalate to calibration chair. Appeals should include concrete examples/evidence.

Jules (SWE): How are IC vs manager promos handled? Different criteria?

Priya (Eng Manager): Criteria differ. IC promos focus on technical leadership, scope, and mentorship. Manager promos emphasize people management, org impact, and cross-team collaboration. The ladder has side-by-side criteria.

Sam (People Ops): A few practical notes:
- Managers: start prepping packets now. We recommend a 30-min calibration prep with your peer managers.
- ICs: prepare 2–3 concise impact bullets and the top 1–2 projects you led.
- Questions about leveling disputes — bring them to calibration, not the all-hands chat.

Noah (SWE): Can comp adjustments be budgeted outside the cycle for retention cases?

Lily (Finance): Yes, for high-risk retention we have an out-of-cycle process. Manager + People Ops must submit justification and hit a minimum business case threshold. Approval goes to Finance + Head of People Ops.

Jules (SWE): Any changes to performance review rubric this year?

Sam (People Ops): Minor tweaks: more emphasis on collaboration and measurable impact. We'll post an annotated rubric by EOD tomorrow.

Priya (Eng Manager): Also flagging that for promos we will accept 2 months of recent impactful work for early-cycle exceptions — clear rationale required.

Ava (Data Scientist): Can we expect training for managers on calibration?

Marta (HRBP): Yes — two calibration workshops next week (May 1 & May 3, 60 mins). RSVP link in Confluence. Mandatory for managers of promo-eligible ICs.

Sam (People Ops): Closing notes: packet template is here: https://redwood.growth/promo-template and checklist below (copyable):

```
- Self-summary: 2-3 bullets
- Manager evidence: 3 bullets + metrics
- Peer notes: up to 3 (optional)
- Manager recommendation: level + comp suggestion
- Growth plan: 3 months post-promo
```

Sam (People Ops): We'll keep updating this thread. If you have private concerns, DM @Sam or @Marta. Thanks! :thumbsup:
